goal: Let wallets test 1-parent-1-child packages and evaluate replacement without modifying the mempool
Avoids submitting unoptimized fee-bumping packages directly to the mempool
agreement: Strong support with demonstrated downstream demand and no blocking objections
Concept approval citing the value of pre-flight testing 1p1c packages (ismaelsadeeq)
Confirmed downstream demand for shaping batch transactions in LND (GeorgeTsagk)
Suggested splitting out internal dry-run logic if RPC demand remains uncertain (andrewtoth)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it enables dry-running 1p1c acceptance and RBF checks without mempool mutation
Useful for wallets and layer-two protocols constructing fee bumps but reasonably deferrable

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it provides a dedicated dry-run endpoint explicitly requested by downstream users
Fills an interface gap for wallets and LND preparing batch transactions without side effects
